review_description: Great to speak to, got back to me straight away and were professional.

Bought the system under the Qld Government Grant and loan scheme, fantastic value and makes the system really affordable , and reassuring to have the Government approved installers with the system checked by another Auditor, it was rated as Industry best practice, very happy!

Thank you Finn for the great information. We received a very good quote as well and very detailed. Perhaps they were a close second quote. I went for quality as opposed to cheap. And the local company were the ones in the end. It has given me a greater understanding of the solar systems. Thank you for you help.
